*   **Wed:**

    *   David: 11:30-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, 16:00-16:30

    *   David: 09:30-10:00, 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00, 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00

This collaborative approach is better than giving up immediately.
